oxygen_vacancy.note: O-vacancies add mid-gap states and improve charge separation; commonly lift visible-light H2.

metal_vacancy.note: Cation (Schottky/point) vacancies tune band structure; usually a modest lift.

nonmetal_doping.note: N/S/C doping narrows the effective gap and extends visible-light absorption.

metal_doping.note: Transition-metal doping adds trap states and can boost charge separation.

heterostructure.note: A type-II / Z-scheme junction (e.g. ZnO/TiO2, g-C3N4/CdS) strongly improves charge separation.

cocatalyst_loading.note: An optimal noble-metal or earth-abundant co-catalyst forms a Schottky junction that extracts electrons.

surface_modification.note: Surface passivation / facet engineering reduces recombination.
